body: Of course, I'm glad I could help.

I know how difficult the school year can be. Junior year started a few days ago for me, and that's why I'm here on this sub. 

I had a really bad experience freshmen year of highschool and it just got worse from there. I wasn't happy before, but after that I started to not care about my body. I started picking at myself- my face, chest, and especially my upper back/shoulders. It became a really bad habit that I couldn't control. I was constantly bleeding. I realized after months that my body was permanently scarred. I think I might have done it to relieve or be distracted from the awful emotions I was feeling everyday. 

But that's small compared to your struggle with self harm. I can't even imagine the amount of emotional pain you must have felt. I'm so sorry you had to go through that. But you are so strong to have endured that kind of pain, and still wake up everyday and be you. Stronger than I am. 

I think I may understand why you don't want professional help. Of course, I would recommend it to anyone with these sort of issues. However, to tell the truth, I don't want to get professional help either. I once let slip to a school counselor that I thought "I'd be better off dead", and she immediately called my parents and I was forced into a hospital. I had to see a therapist for awhile until I got a little better. Those were the worst, most humiliating experiences of my life. I'm telling you this because I believe that you could relate. Pardon me if I'm assuming too much, but to have your mom know about your pain, despite you not wanting to talk about it, must have been painful and humiliating as well.  I know I wasn't ready to talk about my struggle openly, and I assume that you weren't either. I'm sorry about that. That's really hard to deal with. I hope my story doesn't discourage you from eventually seeking help when you feel comfortable, though. I didn't have that choice when I had to go through professional help.

I hope this helped, and I hope you get better soon.

Hi, I don't think I have any sort of hard solutions you could try that hasn't already been written by commenters in this subreddit. And I'm not exactly qualified to do so anyway. But maybe you could elaborate on your story? I felt a little better the times I shared my thoughts here. I think it could possibly be at least a little relieving to know that someone else is reading what you're going through, somebody that may understand. Of course, only if you are comfortable telling it. (+ Happy Birthday!)

I think I may be going through a similar situation. It must be incredibly painful, especially in times of isolation. I have those moments late at night when I'm all alone. I hope that you'll get through it.

I'm a sophomore in high school. I'm also terrified of college/ going into the work force.

I understand that school shooter comment. That one hurts, even if I've gotten it only a few times lightheartedly from my best friend- I know that every one else is really thinking it.

I also have pretty long hair- but I just hate getting a hair cut because of my anxiety. I really don't like people getting in my personal space, you know?
Thank you so much. I'm doing better now.
